TestStand.//EnvironmentPath: Alternate TestStand environment (.tsenv) this server connects to — the in-process equivalent of the Sequence Editor's /env switch. Fixed for the life of the process. Empty = the global environment.
TestStand.//EnvironmentAutoDetect: Search upwards from the first opened .seq for the nearest directory holding exactly one .tsenv. Off by default: it pins the environment implicitly, from a file path.
TestStand.//ConnectTimeoutSeconds: Bound for a single connect attempt, so a modal dialog no headless caller can answer fails instead of hanging the session.
